statement: Median per-capita disposable income growth < mean growth in 2027 annual data (national statistics office; one indicator per leading jurisdiction)
status_at_phase_end: Bloc B statistics office: median growth was below mean growth in every 2025-published release - 2024 annual (5.1% vs 5.3%), Q1 2025 (5.0% vs 5.5%), Jan-Sep 2025 (4.5% vs 5.1%; gap widening, property income +1.7%). Pattern pre-dates any plausible AI effect, so the condition is a base-rate tendency rather than an AI signal. Bloc A still lacks a comparable per-capita disposable median/mean pair.

items.summary: Bloc B 2024 annual household survey: median per-capita disposable income +5.1% vs mean +5.3%; median 84.0% of mean. Median growth slightly below mean growth (urban median and mean both +4.6%).
items.detail: Bloc B NBS 2024 residents' income and consumption release (2025-01-17): mean 41,314 yuan, median 34,707 yuan (CCTV/CNR reprints of NBS release).

items.summary: Bloc B Q1 2025: median per-capita disposable income +5.0% vs mean +5.5%; median 81.6% of mean.
items.detail: Bloc B NBS Q1 2025 income release (2025-04-16): mean 12,179 yuan, median 9,939 yuan; urban median +4.5% vs urban mean +4.9%.

items.summary: Bloc B Jan-Sep 2025: median per-capita disposable income +4.5% vs mean +5.1% (gap 0.6 pp); urban median +3.9% vs urban mean +4.4%; property income +1.7% vs wage income +5.4%.
items.detail: Bloc B NBS Q1-Q3 2025 income release (2025-10-20): mean 32,509 yuan, median 27,149 yuan (83.5% of mean). Verified via stats.gov.cn and gov.cn.

items.summary: Bloc A annual income report for 2024: real median household income ~$83,730, change from 2023 not statistically significant. Household money income, not per-capita disposable income, so not directly comparable.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau 'Income in the Bloc A: 2024' (P60), released 2025-09-09. Value from memory of release coverage; not verified via web_extract this run.

items.summary: No Bloc A official series publishes per-capita disposable-income median and mean growth side by side; a comparable Bloc A series must be constructed. The Bloc B H1 2025 release was not retrieved this run.
items.detail: CPS ASEC = pre-tax household money income; BEA distribution of personal income is a prototype. NBS H1 2025 release (mid-July 2025) not extracted.
